name: QuiX Quantum
description: QuiX Quantum builds photonic quantum processors based on silicon nitride waveguide technology, requiring no cryogenic cooling. The company has deployed over 15 systems worldwide, including 8-qubit and 64-qubit photonic quantum computers to the German Aerospace Centre (DLR), and secured EUR 15M in Series A funding to deliver a universal photonic quantum computer.

products.name: Photonic Quantum Processors
products.description: Silicon nitride waveguide-based photonic quantum processors operating at room temperature without cryogenic cooling

news.title: Enschede-based QuiX Quantum secures €15M to launch first universal photonic quantum computer
news.excerpt: QuiX Quantum secured €15M in Series A funding co-led by Invest NL and EIC Fund to deliver its first-generation universal photonic quantum computer.

news.title: QuiX Quantum Demonstrates Below-Threshold Error Mitigation in Photonic Quantum Computing For First Time
news.excerpt: QuiX Quantum demonstrated 'below threshold' error mitigation on a photonic quantum computer, achieving a net reduction in total errors. The project was conducted on the QuiX Bia Cloud Quantum Computing Service in collaboration with NASA's Quantum AI Lab, University of Twente, and Freie Universität Berlin.

news.title: QuiX Quantum partners with Artilux to improve photonic quantum hardware efficiency
news.excerpt: MoU integrates Artilux's GeSi photonic detectors with QuiX systems to reduce cooling and infrastructure requirements for data-centre deployments.

news.title: QuiX Quantum demonstrates below-threshold error mitigation in photonic quantum computing
news.excerpt: First European company to demonstrate a production-ready photonic error-mitigation method compatible with scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing.

news.title: QuiX Quantum Introduces PACU, a Photonic Assembly Control Unit for Scalable Quantum Systems
news.excerpt: QuiX Quantum launched PACU, a rack-mountable 3U control unit supporting up to 1,000 low-speed and 32 high-speed phase shifters, designed to standardize the photonic hardware layer for scalable quantum systems and ease data-centre integration. The launch marks a strategic shift toward becoming a full-stack, fabless quantum system vendor.
